description: This file implements the SetState command handler for a server management component, allowing setting the state of an application via HTTP requests. It includes a conversion function for session states, a class constructor, and a run method that processes request parameters and interacts with a service to set the application state.

classes.name: SetState
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the 'SetState' command, which sets the state of an application based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: SetState::SetState
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetState handler with references to the service and HTTP request.

methods.name: SetState::run
methods.description: Executes the command to set the application state based on request parameters, and sends an appropriate HTTP response.
